doc: The knowledge file in YAML, with CRLF endings and a comment: reading, then one step for every kind of edit the Knowledge designer makes, each with its exact splices, then undo back to the input.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
A new property goes after the last property, its keys in the binding's order; unset keys are left out.
